entries.name: Block Doctrine
entries.text: +300 block, -90 flat dmg taken — "this -90 dmg is calculated at the end of all calculation, making it very good"
Hero DMG / Piercing DMG / Pen — do not use

doctrines.note: No Mastery (T5). Veterancy: Bot Line. CC-immunity (doctrine + Press 1) is the core value: tank trebs when fighting on walls, eat cav charges or fall back. Kit per OP: White Plume Defense (1) CC-immune +1400 block restore, +80% Def 10s / Shattering Bash (2) knockdown AoE + 4% HP restore / Long Live the Han (3) 10s last-stand + death immunity, 20% HP restore after.

entries.text: High minimum DMG: Liao's, Iron Reapers, Rattans
Units that can get through you: Queen's / Reapers / ..
Everything (per Amya): you soak dmg for the team, and your team cav can enter front if you are baiting enemy pike into hitting you.

You are fixing the front-lane, don't bait your dps units and don't get flanked.
